slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Lambda deployment gotchas
slides.subtitle: The code change is only part of the deployment.

slides.title: More than Python
slides.body: The deployment path includes a container image, ECR, CloudFormation, Function URL, environment variables, and local testing.

slides.title: Use infrastructure as code
slides.body: CloudFormation described the Lambda resources so they could be deployed repeatedly instead of assembled manually.

slides.title: Small flags matter
slides.body: One deployment issue came from Docker image metadata. Lambda rejected the image until provenance metadata was disabled.

slides.title: Write the path down
slides.body: Save the commands, failed attempts, required flags, and cleanup notes. The deployment document becomes part of the system.
